briefs.episode_title: Why the AI boom is about to hit a wall
briefs.channel: AI News & Strategy Daily | Nate B Jones
briefs.one_line_summary: AI vendors are facing capacity constraints due to supply chain limitations affecting hardware manufacturing.
core_claims: Microsoft will spend $190 billion on CAPEX this calendar year but still expects to be capacity constrained through year-end.
AI vendor contracts are evolving from software-based agreements to supply contracts due to hyperscaler spending and resource rationing.
Global data center electricity consumption is projected to roughly double to about 945 terawatt-hours by 2030.
briefs.positioning_implication: Re-evaluate AI investment strategies to account for infrastructure limitations and supply chain dependencies.

briefs.episode_title: Will End Of Iran War & New Rate Cut Hopes Be Enough For Silver in 2026?
briefs.one_line_summary: Silver's price consolidation amidst geopolitical news and rate cut expectations may trigger an upward trend, though hitting $300 this summer is unlikely.
core_claims: Silver price is not consistently making lower lows and lower highs on a monthly closing basis.
Silver's lows in April and May were higher than the previous months.
An upward trend for silver is evident when looking at the average annual price since 2000.
Expect $60 silver by 2026 due to the crunch on supply.
If the silver price replicates the most explosive five-month period ever between September 1979 and January 1980, silver could reach $332 an ounce.
Silver's price may recover and see new highs in mid-July, aligning with Michael Oliver's timeline.
briefs.positioning_implication: Consider a cautiously optimistic outlook for silver, anticipating upward movement but calibrating expectations based on conservative growth models and Federal Reserve actions.  Allocate capital gradually to account for volatility.

briefs.episode_title: Silver to $100 by July, $200 by the Year-End – This Is How the Price Will Move | Mario Innecco
briefs.one_line_summary: A global sovereign debt crisis is coming, and gold may reach $7,000 by year-end while silver hits $100 by July.
core_claims: Gold could reach $7,000 by the end of this year.
Silver can reach $100 per ounce by July.
A global sovereign debt crisis is imminent.
The conflict in Iran will accelerate de-dollarization.
briefs.positioning_implication: Shift portfolio allocation towards hard assets, anticipating currency system instability and accelerated de-dollarization.
